newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Jan container throughput falls 0.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Jan container throughput falls 0.8 pct.

text.p: The Port of Singapore Authority (PSA) said on Wednesday January container throughput fell to 1.105 million TEU (twenty-foot equivalent units), down 0.8 percent from December.
PSA said in its latest monthly report that container throughput registered for December was 1.114 million TEU.
Total cargo tonnage moving through Singapore in January also fell to 25,744 million tonnes from December's 26,747 million, it said.
In January, 10,724 vessels called at the port, compared with 10,294 in December.
Bunker fuel sales for 380-centistoke fuel oil were 793,800 tonnes in January, down from 840,000 tonnes in December.
But 180-centistoke fuel oil sales were at 380,800 tonnes, up from December's 346,000 tonnes
